notes: Final close of KKR's 5th Core+ infrastructure vintage; largest infra fund KKR has raised; brings ~$45B raised across latest infra vintages globally. Already committed >$9B across Altitude III, EDF Power Solutions North America, Enilive, FiberCop, Global Technical Realty (build-to-suit data centers), Gulf Data Hub (MENA colocation), Metronet, Sempra Infrastructure, The Parking Spot. Corroborated by Bloomberg (https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-08-03/kkr-raises-19-2-billion-for-biggest-ever-infrastructure-fund) and DCD.

Blue Owl-managed funds lead $2.4B compute-equipment financing for IREN: $1.2B senior secured term loan + $1.2B senior secured notes, funding IREN's purchase of air-cooled NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPUs for its Mackenzie, BC data center campus. Structured to draw in tranches as hardware is delivered/commissioned -- stated total facility is $2.4B. Corroborated by Bloomberg (https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-08-28/blue-owl-leads-2-4-billion-iren-debt-deal-to-buy-nvidia-s-chips).

A DigitalBridge-managed investment vehicle agreed to acquire PLUS ES, the ring-fenced smart-metering entity within Ausgrid Group, from Ausgrid -- ~2M meters across Australia's National Electricity Market, serving retailers/utilities/network operators. Deal value not disclosed by either party. Subject to customary closing conditions incl. regulatory approval; not yet closed. Corroborated by Bloomberg (https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-08-27/softbank-linked-digitalbridge-to-buy-australian-smart-meter-unit).
